title: Spiritual Growth
definition: Spiritual growth is the ongoing maturing of believers in faith, holiness, love, knowledge, obedience, and Christlike character.
summary: Spiritual growth is becoming more like Christ over time by God's grace.
christFocus: Jesus grows His people through His Word, Spirit, discipline, Church, and grace until they are conformed to His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual growth is God's ongoing work in believers as they mature in Christ. It includes deeper knowledge of God, stronger faith, greater holiness, increased love, wiser discernment, and faithful service.

Growth is both God's work and the believer's responsibility. Christians are called to pursue godliness, practice obedience, receive Scripture, pray, serve, and remain connected to the Church.

Spiritual growth is often gradual. It may include struggle, correction, suffering, and repentance, but God faithfully continues His work in those who belong to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people become discouraged because they expect instant maturity or measure growth by emotion alone. Spiritual growth matters because it gives a biblical picture of patient, Spirit-formed transformation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue growth through ordinary means of grace: Scripture, prayer, fellowship, worship, service, repentance, and obedience. Look for steady fruit rather than instant perfection.
